description: Na₂Pr₄NOBr₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.16 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Br atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaBr₆ pentagonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-Br bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.18 Å. There are four inequivalent Pr sites. In the first Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and six Br atoms. The Pr-N bond length is 2.36 Å. The Pr-O bond length is 2.42 Å. There are a spread of Pr-Br bond distances ranging from 3.04-3.25 Å. In the second Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and six Br atoms. The Pr-N bond length is 2.35 Å. The Pr-O bond length is 2.41 Å. There are a spread of Pr-Br bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.32 Å. In the third Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and seven Br atoms. The Pr-N bond length is 2.31 Å. The Pr-O bond length is 2.42 Å. There are a spread of Pr-Br bond distances ranging from 3.05-3.56 Å. In the fourth Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one N, one O, and seven Br atoms. The Pr-N bond length is 2.36 Å. The Pr-O bond length is 2.36 Å. There are a spread of Pr-Br bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.55 Å. N is bonded to four Pr atoms to form NPr₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent OPr₄ tetrahedra. O is bonded to four Pr atoms to form OPr₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent NPr₄ tetrahedra. There are nine inequivalent Br sites. In the first Br site, Br is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na and four Pr atoms. In the second Br site, Br is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Na and four Pr atoms. In the third Br site, Br is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Pr atoms. In the fourth Br site, Br is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Pr atoms. In the fifth Br site, Br is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Pr atoms. In the sixth Br site, Br is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Pr atoms. In the seventh Br site, Br is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Pr atoms. In the eighth Br site, Br is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Pr atoms. In the ninth Br site, Br is bonded in a see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Pr atoms.
